general.description: Parma central is the main station controlling the array of power plant in the vincity of Algol's Stars. It house a small crew of engineers and scientist, managing the good work and the station, and sometimes studying the solar's tempest of Algol. The main works is handled by robots, given the high solar winds and radiations provided by Algol A and B, solar winds that feeds the central's Array. Resulting energy is loaded in convoy and sent to Gliese 250 via the nearby leap point.
general.bar: In the middle of recharging robots, a dozen of teams members of the crew station are taking their break, devising with one or two scientists, and taking bets about petty things, waiting eagerly for the next relief team.
